{{Youmay|the security force employed at Bantha Traxx|the [[Hylobon Enforcers]] of Crimson Dawn}}
The '''Enforcers''' were the security force employed at [[Bantha Traxx]]. Comprised of eight [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] led by [[Jik'Tal]], the Enforcers wore black [[Leather/Legends|leather]] [[Robe/Legends|robes]] and were licensed to carry a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]] and [[stun pistol]]. The Jawas were ferocious and effective fighters who were trained by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Ne'Chak]].<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
